# E0305: missing trait member

A trait impl defines every method and constant of the trait that has no default. Add the missing member.

- Rule: [`traits.impl-members`](../../reference/11-traits.md#traits.impl-members)
- Reported at: the impl's `impl` keyword.
- Tier: `core`, checked in the `items` phase

## Example

This program makes the mistake:

```stilt E0305:8
trait Shape {
  fn area(self) -> f64
  fn name(self) -> str
}

type Circle = { radius: f64 }

impl Shape for Circle {
  fn area(self) -> f64 { 3.14 * self.radius * self.radius }
}
```

This one is fixed:

```stilt
trait Shape {
  fn area(self) -> f64
  fn name(self) -> str
}

type Circle = { radius: f64 }

impl Shape for Circle {
  fn area(self) -> f64 { 3.14 * self.radius * self.radius }
  fn name(self) -> str { "circle" }
}
```

## What the compiler prints

`stilt check` on [`E0305_missing_trait_method.lt`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0305_missing_trait_method.lt):

```text
── MISSING TRAIT MEMBER ───────────── E0305_missing_trait_method.lt:8:1  [E0305]

The impl of `Shape` for `Circle` lacks the method `name`:

  8 │ impl Shape for Circle {
    │ ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

A trait impl defines every method and constant of the trait that has no default.
Add the missing member.
```
